title: Atomic return and manifest finalization
description: Publish canonical durable returns and manifests atomically and consume a sidecar identity receipt.

clauses.text: Build mutable return/manifest content without a self-referential raw-byte digest. Use the deterministic finalizer to canonicalize, fill generated fields, validate schema, resolve referenced identities, and publish the immutable object atomically.
Use the finalizer sidecar identity receipt for byte count and SHA-256. Never hand-edit a finalized object to repair its identity fields.
A carrier-only fix invalidates only its receipt and directly dependent package closure; preserve unchanged candidate, test, assertion, and product evidence.
